DELIVERY_FAILED.scenario: A POST rejected or returned a failed status; retry only according to the transport hint.

INVALID_OPTION.scenario: Retry-After's admitted bound is negative or nonfinite; correct the factory option.

SERIALIZE_FAILED.scenario: JSON projection failed before any POST; inspect the original payload through cause.

TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE.scenario: No injected or host fetch capability exists; inject a fetcher before creating this output.
